tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground — unbleached market canvas by day; deep lake by night. Carries the paper grain texture.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, menus and anything lifted off `canvas`.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Kraft-paper wells, table header rows, tag grounds, the newsletter card. Takes `ink`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules, card outlines and dotted ornaments. Not for control edges (below 3:1).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox edges; outline buttons on light grounds. ≥3:1 on `canvas` and `paper` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the illustration outline colour. Reads on `canvas`, `paper`, `kraft`, `sage` and every `*-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — hints, metadata, captions — on `canvas`, `paper` and `kraft`.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Deep-water ground for the utility bar, hero overlays, footer and night sections. Takes `on-deep`.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on `deep` in both themes (13:1).

tokens.name: bay
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue (the bay). Links, primary buttons, nav underline, Summer Market. Readable as text on `canvas` and `paper`.

tokens.name: bay-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed for `bay`.

tokens.name: on-bay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `bay` and `bay-strong`.

tokens.name: bay-tint
tokens.usage: Info notices, selected rows, dairy tags. Takes `ink`.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Lake-glass highlight: wave carvings, rules and eyebrows on `deep`. Decorative on light grounds.

tokens.name: heirloom
tokens.usage: Heirloom-tomato red: the headline call to action (Accent button), announcement bar, ribbons, Night Market dates. Takes `on-heirloom`.

tokens.name: heirloom-strong
tokens.usage: Hover for `heirloom`; ribbon tails; sign-painter drop shadow under hero type.

tokens.name: on-heirloom
tokens.usage: Text on `heirloom` fills.

tokens.name: heirloom-text
tokens.usage: Red as text: errors, required marks, danger badges on `canvas`, `paper`, `heirloom-tint`.

tokens.name: heirloom-tint
tokens.usage: Danger / closure notices, meat & prepared-food tags. Takes `ink`.

tokens.name: corn
tokens.usage: Sweet-corn gold: sunbursts, ornaments, stars, rules on `deep`, Pop-Up Market. Always takes `on-corn` text — never white.

tokens.name: on-corn
tokens.usage: Text on `corn` fills in both themes.

tokens.name: corn-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text: warning badges on `canvas`, `paper`, `corn-tint`.

tokens.name: corn-tint
tokens.usage: Weather / warning notices, bakery tags. Takes `ink`.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Sage band ground — newsletter strip, food-access panels. Takes `ink` (light) / `ink` (dark).

tokens.name: kale
tokens.usage: Kale green: success, SNAP/EBT, produce. Takes `on-kale`.

tokens.name: on-kale
tokens.usage: Text on `kale` fills.

tokens.name: kale-text
tokens.usage: Green as text: success badges and confirmations on `canvas`, `paper`, `kale-tint`.

tokens.name: kale-tint
tokens.usage: Success notices, produce tags. Takes `ink`.

tokens.name: beet
tokens.usage: Beet: Winter Market and flowers & crafts only. Takes `on-beet`.

tokens.name: on-beet
tokens.usage: Text on `beet` fills.

tokens.name: beet-tint
tokens.usage: Flowers & crafts tags. Takes `ink`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring — 3px solid, 2px offset, lands on the surface behind the control.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline only, uppercase, `on-deep` or `canvas` with the `heirloom-strong` sign-painter shadow. One per page.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: Card and event titles, footer headings. Uppercase.

styles.name: script-l
styles.usage: Accent line above a display title, the tagline, ribbons. Never more than five words; never for information.

styles.name: script-m
styles.usage: Section eyebrows, pull-quote attributions, sub-brand marks.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Local growers, bakers and makers every Saturday morning by the lake.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring a bag — most stalls take cards, cash and SNAP/EBT tokens.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase nav links, button labels, tags, table heads.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag/badge padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Compact card padding; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; between groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero padding; poster margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, notices, image corners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, event tickets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, circle tiles' labels.

shadow.note: Print-like: hard offset shadows in ink, like a screenprint slightly off register — never soft grey blurs on brand surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-print
tokens.usage: Cards on hover, the hero logo, featured tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-print-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons on hover, badges on photos.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Menus and the sticky header only.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero buttons.
